scope: 40 additional polygonal reference vehicles, two per year from 2005–2024

checks.reproducibility: generate-fleet.mjs --check passed for the entire fleet, including previous Bendy and recent reference models
checks.captures: Four exterior angles, neutral-lit scene and exact driverEye per model; bulk images local

limitations: Stylized reference interpretations with rounded dimensions and simplified trim/cabins
Game handling, not manufacturer performance simulation
Analog speed and steering are bound where present; screen graphics are illustrative
No door, roof, tailgate or cargo-access animation
Near-view masters use host distance/proxy policies; no separate authored GLB LOD chain

models.label: 2021 Ford Transit
models.trim: T-250 cargo, regular length, medium roof
